attribution: estimasi tim yang diselaraskan ke basis data berlisensi (calibration trail: internal)
fx_basis: implied by FY2025A: Sectors revenue Rp 30,904 bn / BRIDS FY2025A US$1,847 mn = 16.73 Rp bn per US$1 mn (equivalent to 16,732 IDR/USD, the same-year, same-company cross-check, not a market-rate assumption).

revenue.note: Phase-8 ramp (fresh ore 1Mt in 1Q25 to 38Mt in 1Q26) plus smelter/PMR downstream volume, new processing plant first ore 3Q26F (40 to 85Mtpa)

ebitda.note: margin 50.6% / 62.3% / 67.8%; the ramp dilutes cost per tonne as volumes normalise

capex.note: post-build normalisation: 1,424 in FY2025A, 498 in FY26F

interest_expense.note: falls with the debt repayment path, not a flat coupon on frozen debt

gross_debt.source: BRIDS Exhibit 42, ST Debt + Long Term Debt
gross_debt.note: deleveraging out of free cash flow: 6,258 in FY26F to 2,936 in FY28F

fcf.note: free cash flow after tax, capex and working capital, as published

working_capital.source: BRIDS Exhibit 43, Change in Working Capital (cash effect as published; negative = outflow)
working_capital.note: dipakai apa adanya sebagai dampak kas, bukan diubah tandanya

bvps_path.source: Q1-2026 attributable equity Rp 93.687 tn + retained earnings (payout = 0.0 since 2023-07-07 listing, Sectors dividend + corporate-actions both null); net-profit path from drivers.net_profit above; shares = Sectors overview.shares_outstanding 72,518,217,656 (FY2025 buyback applied to all years)
bvps_path.note: BVPS[t] = (equity Q1-2026 + cumulative net profit FY26F..FY28F) / 72.518 bn shares. Opening anchor = Q1-2026 'Jumlah Ekuitas yang Dapat Diatribusikan kepada Pemilik Entitas Induk' from audited interim FS (data/assumptions/AMMN.json gate_inputs.shareholders_equity, Rp 93,687,393,398,000). Path published here so PBV(t) = price/BVPS(t) varies per column.

2024A.bvps_formula: FY2024 year-end equity attributable to parent / 72.518 bn shares
2024A.equity_source: Sectors Q4-2024 freeze (output/cache/ammn_fill/quarterly_AMMN_8.json, date=2024-12-31, total_equity=Rp 84,798,398,800,000). Parent equity = total minus NCI; NCI 1.704% means parent = 98.296% of total.

2025A.bvps_formula: FY2025 year-end equity attributable to parent / 72.518 bn shares
2025A.equity_source: Sectors Q4-2025 freeze (output/cache/ammn_fill/quarterly_AMMN_8.json, date=2025-12-31, total_equity=Rp 90,897,588,743,520). Same parent/total split as 2024A.

2026F.bvps_formula: (equity Q1-2026 parent Rp 93.687 tn + FY26F net profit Rp 15.208 tn) / 72.518 bn shares

2027F.bvps_formula: (equity Q1-2026 parent + cumulative net profit FY26F..FY27F) / 72.518 bn shares

2028F.bvps_formula: (equity Q1-2026 parent + cumulative net profit FY26F..FY28F) / 72.518 bn shares

cross_check.note: The normalised mid-cycle level stays in data/assumptions/AMMN.json for the valuation's mid-cycle multiple leg; this path drives the forecast COLUMNS.

independence_note: Jalur earnings FY26F-FY28F mengikuti estimasi pihak ketiga yang dikutip per driver di atas; multiple, WACC, beta, dan keputusan gate tetap milik rumah, bukan milik sumber estimasi.
